outcome: Use of any analgesia during delivery
cohort: Women who delivered neonates weighing above 500g at a university hospital in Dublin, Ireland, between 2009 and 2013, excluding those with missing data, elective cesarean deliveries, and use of analgesia during treatment for obstetric complications
finding: Migrant women, particularly those from Africa, were less likely to use neuraxial or any analgesia during delivery compared to women from Western Europe.
